issue_request: FHIR-7185 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 ClinicalImpression. It requested a boundary clarification distinguishing ClinicalImpression from Condition by describing it as the outcome of the clinical assessment process and the A in SOAP, and it requested renaming ClinicalImpression.action to supportingInfo 0..* Reference(Any) with definition 'Information supporting the clinical impression.' The Jira record also noted that ClinicalImpression.plan had already been removed by another change.
initial_application: Git commit 5596f16348577cb6da1e332d48404a9bf6c17305 historically applied GF#7185 by adding the SOAP/Condition boundary paragraph and renaming the authored ClinicalImpression.action row to ClinicalImpression.supportingInfo with Reference(Any), the requested definition, and GF#7185 notes. The inactive ClinicalImpression and renamed ClinicalAssessment source folders still preserve that substantive content.
additional_context: FHIR-11167 and FHIR-11168, already audited on the combined branch, cover the adjacent plan/action scope history. FHIR-46596 later renamed ClinicalImpression to ClinicalAssessment, and an existing FHIR-46596 reconciliation fixed active core narrative references. Commit fad1b9cf84ef652e88947e1a13b026c62f95334e removed ClinicalAssessment from source/fhir.ini's active resource list; current core pages point to the PC incubator ClinicalAssessment artifact. Patient Care Zulip later confirmed ClinicalAssessment was voted out of R6 core to Additional Resources.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source was changed because neither ClinicalImpression nor ClinicalAssessment is active in the current core build; editing the remaining inactive resource folders would not affect the built specification, and the current PC incubator artifact already carries the boundary/supportingInfo semantics.
